notes:
Intro: product leader (CTO + Head of ML) — building a GitHub-style PR assistant for enterprise customers.

Key ask: low-latency streaming for IDE copilots (VS Code plugin) + server-side PR review batch jobs. Must support model/version pinning for reproducible comments and rerank results.

Quote from call (2026-02-18): "We need summaries that match our internal reviewer tone — reduce noise, highlight security & API changes first."

Requirements summary:
- Workloads: real-time streaming in IDE (human-in-loop) + async reranking for large change sets.
- Latency targets: interactive streaming p50 <35ms, p95 <120ms for token generation; end-to-end diff summarize <800ms for small PRs (under 200 LOC).
- Throughput: expect 150-300 concurrent editor sessions initially; batch reranker jobs ~50/HR.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for predictable reserved capacity but want Optimize recommendations to reduce unit cost for large repos.
- Model preferences: prefer Llama-family + small proprietary models; want Redwood-managed model catalog + ability to pin exact model version and quantization profile.
- Routing/fallback: primary hosted -> dedicated fallback in same region; fall back to smaller quantized variant on overload.
- Data controls: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, configurable retention (30/90/365), KMS integration for keys.

Security review status: initial questionnaire submitted (SEC-2107), red team follow-up scheduled after POC. Customer requests SOC2 attestation and encryption-in-transit+at-rest.
